aiImport.title: AI Import
aiImport.privacyDescription: Files, prompts, model output, and passwords stay on this device. AI suggestions may miss or mismatch records, so review every field before saving.
aiImport.modelHint: Models are downloaded from a fixed Hugging Face allowlist and verified with SHA-256. Expo Go is not supported.
aiImport.cancelDownloadConfirm: Cancel the {{name}} download? Downloaded data will be removed.
aiImport.filesHint: CSV, TXT, and Markdown only. Up to 5 files, 5MB each, 15MB total.
aiImport.reviewHint: Nothing is saved automatically. Edit, deselect, or remove anything that is not exact.
aiImport.onboardTitle: Import passwords from mixed files and review them before saving.
aiImport.onboardDescription: Choose password exports or notes. The desktop app parses them locally, asks the bundled llama.cpp model to extract likely credentials, and lets you fix anything before it reaches the database.
aiImport.supportedDescription: CSV, PDF, DOCX, Markdown, and TXT. Image OCR is not enabled for the local text provider yet.
aiImport.selectedFilesHint: Files stay on this device. Only selected text excerpts are sent to the local llama.cpp runtime.
aiImport.reviewExtractedHint: Edit any field, uncheck entries you do not want, then save the rest.
aiImport.processingHint: This MVP runs the import workflow locally, then brings back editable results for review.
aiImport.emptyTitle: Start by choosing files to import
aiImport.emptyHint: The imported results will appear here for manual confirmation and edits.
aiImport.extractionFinishedHint: Review the imported credentials before saving them.
aiImport.credentialsSavedHint: {{count}} imported entries were added to the vault.
aiImport.importCanceledHint: The current onboarding session was discarded.

breach.offlineHint: Some passwords couldn't be checked. Showing partial results; try again when you're online.
